verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Cua Driver acting as an MCP server that external agents such as Claude Code, Codex and Cursor connect to. Nothing shows Cua itself acting as an MCP client that can plug in third-party MCP servers and use their tools. Server-side MCP exposure is a different role and does not count toward this client-side story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
